description: Generates a structured Markdown handoff file to move an active conversation into a new chat, preserving full context, decisions, artifacts, and a ready-to-paste resume prompt. ALWAYS trigger this skill when the user says "move to a new chat", "move this to a new chat", "handoff", "/handoff", "continue in a new chat", "let's move", "new conversation", or any variation indicating they want to transfer the current session to a fresh Claude conversation. Do NOT ask for clarification — execute immediately and produce the .md file.
